item.title: Village of Great Neck approves dry well replacement for new village hall
item.description: The Village of Great Neck Board of Trustees unanimously approved $30,250 for the replacement of a damaged dry well discovered during construction of the new village hall. item.title: Know your numbers: Increased focus on controlling blood pressure
item.description: High blood pressure, or hypertension, damages blood vessels and organs over time and is a major risk factor for heart disease, stroke and other health conditions, including kidney disease, dementia and retinal disease. item.title: ICE vows detention reforms in Central Islip after judge finds fault
item.description: After being faulted by a judge for poor conditions and excessive detention in a holding cell, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement has agreed to a wide range of measures at its Central Islip federal courthouse facility.
